title: Executable Stage 2 exit gate with a cellular criterion that requires beating the training-cohort mean
purpose: AGENTS section 9 states the Stage 2 exit gate in prose. This contract turns it into a re-runnable check that reads immutable evidence artifacts by checksum and reports each leg separately. v3 changes one criterion: the cellular leg reads the normalized error ratio itself and requires it to be strictly below 1.0, so a frozen model counts as predicting a held-out cellular response only when it beats the mean of its own training cells (ADR-2026-010).

supersedes.what_changes: the cellular leg criterion; every artifact pin and every other leg is unchanged
supersedes.why: v1 and v2 passed the cellular leg on a preregistered ratio limit of 1.2 that the frozen family met at 1.064 while predicting worse than the two-cell training mean. A gate statement that says 'predicted in amplitude' cannot be satisfied by a model a constant curve beats.

gate_statement.text: Held-out cellular, synaptic and circuit responses are predicted in time and amplitude, not merely activation order. Key predictions survive plausible parameter/model ensembles. A cellular or synaptic prediction counts only if it beats the training-cohort mean on the held-out cells.

legs.requirement: A held-out cellular response is predicted in amplitude by a model frozen beforehand, better than the training-cohort mean predicts it.
sufficiency_caveats: the held-out cells come from the same paper under a chronic-exposure condition that the paper reports leaves firing-rate curves and input resistance unchanged, so this is a same-population holdout
only firing rate is scored; resting voltage, membrane time constant and adaptation are not predicted by this model at all

the frozen family's held-out RMSE is 13.17 Hz against 12.38 Hz for the two-cell training mean, ratio 1.064; the holdout's own preregistered limit of 1.2 was met and is recorded in its artifact, but under this gate the leg fails

legs.requirement: A held-out synaptic response is predicted in time and amplitude against preregistered numeric feature limits.
sufficiency_caveats: the source traces were aligned on their peaks by the authors, so every one of the twelve recorded waveforms peaks on the same sample; the peak-time criterion therefore measures the alignment convention and the kernel's own onset, and the inward-sign criterion is satisfied by selection; only the decay criterion is informative, and it fails

the amplitude leg was excluded on a state-confound argument that the source paper does not support: it reports unitary amplitudes and kinetics indistinguishable between solvent and exposed cells, so the kernel's 13.6 pA median underprediction on these five cells is a model error, not a state difference
even a pass would leave release failure and short-term plasticity untested; the source paper's release probability of 0.79 and depression onset near 50 spikes per second are registered but unmodelled

legs.requirement: A held-out circuit response is predicted, not merely the activation order.
sufficiency_caveats: the reference is archived FlyWire simulation output, not biological response data, so even a pass here would not settle the circuit leg biologically

the 0.8 coverage threshold is set by this contract and is not derived from any source; positive-response coverage asks only whether the readout fires at frequencies where the reference fires, which is weaker than the gate statement's 'time and amplitude'

the transferred circuit is a one-hop induced subgraph of 41 neurons between mapped inputs and readouts, while the reference simulated the whole brain, so a rate mismatch between the two is structural before any biophysical mechanism is invoked

legs.requirement: Key predictions survive a plausible parameter and model ensemble of the VAL-01 shape.
sufficiency_caveats: the ensemble has the required five-by-four shape but every registered held-out recording is consumed, so no prediction has been scored across it

the accepted members span a 27-fold range of refractory period and a 38-fold range of adaptation time constant at a 25 percent loss tolerance, so a future score across this ensemble would report the width of an unconstrained family rather than the robustness of a prediction

supporting_evidence.role: records which V1 observables are measured at all and for which cell classes, with the review diagnostics that show what the primary values assume
records whether contact number could carry the type-pair scale ND-04 requires, against the corrected statement of the published claim

acceptance.partial_pass_is_not_a_pass: Stage 2 does not exit on a subset. A leg that passes is recorded so the remaining work is visible, not so the stage can be declared complete.

tier_policy: This contract evaluates a stage exit gate and awards no validation tier. Tiers are awarded only by immutable evidence bundles.
claim_boundary: A mechanical re-evaluation of the recorded Stage 2 exit criteria against checksum-pinned artifacts. The cellular criterion is the one this contract tightens; the others are inherited from v1 with their caveats.
